payload.justification: derived from the conditions actually met: reproducible across one round (round-1), controls valid=false, corroborated=false, basis http_only
what_would_raise_the_grade: a second independently authorized round reproducing this signal; this subject rests on one round (round-1)
valid positive and negative controls on the same path and method: no positive control read as a rejection, so the detector set has nothing to calibrate against
a source outside the HTTP exchange -- a filter log entry or a configuration export -- that agrees with the reading; without one the grade cannot pass probable_without_corroboration
to exclude waf: compare the response with the same probe sent to the origin directly, under its own authorization: a filter rule disappears on that path and an application reaction does not
to exclude origin_application: send the same probe to the origin bypassing the front layer, under separate authorization
to exclude reverse_proxy_or_cdn: resolve the origin behind the edge and probe it directly under its own authorization, or read the edge platform's own block identifiers in a log export
to exclude load_balancer_or_infrastructure: repeat across several rounds and, where the scope allows, against each node address: an infrastructure rule is uniform across them, a node-local one is not

to exclude application_authorization: carry valid credentials obtained under the same authorization and compare; a 401/403 that persists for benign traffic on the same route is the session, not the payload
to exclude test_harness_artifact: run the inertness gate over the corpus item and replay the reference probe with the payload removed: identical answers exclude the harness, divergent ones do not
to exclude framework_input_normalization: compare the reading for canonical encoding against the canonical form on the same vector: a normalization difference changes one and not the other
to exclude routing_divergence: issue the identical probe against a second authorized path on the same origin: a routing difference changes the answer, a filter rule does not
